worldcombat.skill.seismictoss.summary: A close grab deals fixed damage based on the user’s level and weight. After a brief pause, a foe still within reach is launched upward. Knockback resistance and terrain govern the flight; the shorter slam form adds its pin only on an actual landing.
worldcombat.skill.seismictoss.descriptio: The grab deals %1$s fixed damage based on the user’s level and weight, without an Attack/Defence ratio. Type immunity and the target’s native damage rules still apply.
After %1$s s of wind-up, grab ahead with a lateral radius of about %3$s blocks. Pause for %2$s s, then throw only if the target remains nearby with no obstruction.

Add %1$s blocks/tick horizontally and %2$s blocks/tick upward. Resistance and terrain determine the arc. The impact and slam-form pin occur only if the target actually lands during the brief tracking period.
worldcombat.skill.seismictoss.slam.on: Slam form: on landing the target is pinned for %1$s s and cannot move (this throw is shorter and steeper).
worldcombat.skill.seismictoss.slam.off: Sling form: a longer, flatter throw that hurls the target away from cover, but pins nothing.
worldcombat.skill.seismictoss.timing: Range %1$s blocks; prepare %2$s s, recover %3$s s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.seismictoss.use.0: Grab a foe and hurl it
worldcombat.skill.seismictoss.use.1: Throw an enemy clear of cover or off a ledge
worldcombat.skill.seismictoss.use.2: Deal level damage to a high-defence target
worldcombat.skill.seismictoss.preference: On: a shorter, steeper throw that pins the target where it lands. Off: a longer, flatter throw that hurls the target away from cover but pins nothing.
Beyond this distance the user closes in instead of grabbing; a wall blocks the grab, so point-blank is safer.
On: prefer this fixed damage to finish a low-health target; off: rank it among ordinary melee candidates.
When on, the user may leave its post to grab; when off, it only grabs what it can reach from where it stands.
worldcombat.skill.seismictoss.growth.1: From level %1$s the pin lasts %2$s s.
